$comment: Product definitions applied by scripts/Import-ApimApi.ps1. The products themselves are created by infra/modules/apim.bicep; this file carries the parts that belong with the policies rather than with the infrastructure - the descriptions a partner reads and which policy file goes with which product.

products.name: booking-starter
products.description: Evaluation access to the Booking API. 20 requests per minute and 5,000 per day, approved automatically. Intended for integration work against non-production data.
products.terms: Evaluation use only. Limits may change without notice. No availability commitment.

products.name: booking-premium
products.description: Production access to the Booking API. 600 requests per minute with a 40-per-5-seconds burst allowance, and 500,000 per day. Requests are approved manually.
products.terms: Production use. Subject to the integration agreement. 99.9% monthly availability target.
